headline: Apple tightens macOS disk access controls over AI agent risks
summary: Apple said it will add new controls around macOS's Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users' files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.

claims.statement: Apple is tightening macOS's Full Disk Access controls, citing increased risk from AI agents with broad access to files, messages and data.

sources.quote: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS’s Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users’ files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.
